description: This PHP source file implements the third step of a record merging interface in SuiteCRM. It retrieves multiple records, displays their fields for comparison and merging, and includes logic for rendering fields, handling different data types, and managing merge operations within the web UI.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: A class used for encoding data structures into JSON format for client-side scripting.

classes.name: TimeDate
classes.description: A class providing date and time utilities, such as getting the user-specific date/time format.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and retrieving Bean objects representing database records.

classes.name: TeamSetManager
classes.description: A utility class for managing team sets associated with records.

classes.name: javascript
classes.description: A helper class for generating JavaScript validation code based on bean field definitions.

methods.name: display_field_value
methods.description: Truncates and displays the field value, adding hover text if truncated.

methods.name: show_field
methods.description: Determines if a field should participate in the merge process based on vardef properties and custom rules.

methods.name: get_related_name
methods.description: Fetches the related record’s display name using relation vardef entries and the given ID.
